info.name: Thrive Global Partner audio experiences programs API
Get a chronic condition program with weekly content

params.name: week
params.description: Return a single week (0-indexed, 0 = welcome). Omit for all 52 weeks.

params.name: contentTypes
params.description: Comma-separated content types to include. Omit for all.

items.docs: Returns the full program structure with weekly content items. Each item has a `contentType` discriminator (article, roleModel, recipe, reset, microstep, lesson). Currently supports the GLP-1 Companion program.
